item.papon.taco_coupon.tooltip.1: Give it to a Papon. He knows a place.
message.papon.coupon_accepted: Papon reads the Taco Coupon... and sets off for the nearest Taco Truck!
message.papon.coupon_rules: He will only walk while someone is with him. Leave him alone and he sits down to grill.
message.papon.no_trucks_here: Papon squints at the coupon. There are no taco trucks in this dimension.
message.papon.waiting: Papon is waiting at the Taco Truck. The grill is heating up...

speech.papon.don_pollo.order: ¡Tres tacos de pollo, mi hermano! ¡Con mucha salsa!
speech.papon.don_pollo.order.gloss: Three chicken tacos, my brother! With lots of salsa!

speech.papon.don_pollo.leave.gloss: Damn! This salsa is spicy, my brother! It burns so much!
speech.papon.don_pollo.phone.gloss: Hello? It's Don Pollo! I'm eating, call me later!
speech.papon.edp445.order: Yo lemme get uhh... twelve tacos bro. Twelve. Go Birds.
speech.papon.edp445.leave: Yo these tacos is heat bro, straight mother fuckin heat bro
speech.papon.badlands_chugs.order: Lemme get a gallon of horchata. Actually... make it two.
speech.papon.badlands_chugs.watch: Hold up. Hold up. Watch this.
speech.papon.reviewbrah.order: Good evening. I'll have the number three, please, and a medium horchata.
speech.papon.reviewbrah.leave: This taco is... simply delicious. I'd give it a %s out of 10.
speech.papon.reviewbrah.signoff: Thanks for joining me, everyone. Have a good evening.
speech.papon.vendor.inspect.gloss: A coupon? Let's see, let's see...
speech.papon.vendor.suspicious: Mmm... esto no se ve bien...
speech.papon.vendor.fraud.gloss: A FAKE COUPON?! FRAUD! NOBODY STEALS MY TACOS!
speech.papon.wandering.present: ¡Un taco, por favor! Tengo un cupón.
speech.papon.wandering.present.gloss: One taco, please! I have a coupon.
